source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of common design patterns (PDF 25).

blocks.text: Design patterns bohat se hain, magar kuch zyada istemal hote hain kyunke woh har fan mola aur bohat se masail ke liye moassar hain. Is chapter ke sab se mashhoor patterns Singleton, Factory, Observer aur Strategy hain.

blocks.caption: Chaar aam design patterns
rows: ek qism ka sirf ek object banta aur mushtarka hota hai
khaas kamre ki ek chaabi jo sab istemal karte hain
object maangein; factory tay karti hai ke kaise banana hai
workshop jo aap ko tayyar product deta hai
source badalne par tamam dilchaspi rakhne walon ko batata hai
subscribers jinhein har update ki khabar milti hai
kisi kaam ke kai badalne qabil tareeqe
auzaar ka dabba: kaam ke mutabiq auzaar chunein

blocks.text: Class activity: apne ird gird koi haqeeqi soorat pehchanein jahan in mein se koi design pattern lagaya ja sake, aur agli class mein apni misal batayein.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa pattern us news app ke liye munasib hai jo nayi khabar shaya hone par har subscribed user ko ittila de?
blocks.explanation: Observer pattern: news source tamam subscribed users ko khud-ba-khud ittila deta hai, to unhein baar baar dekhna nahi parta.

items: Aam patterns: Singleton (ek mushtarka nuskha), Factory (object banana chhupa hua), Observer (subscribers ko ittila), Strategy (badalne qabil tareeqe).
